sections.title: Negation and main-clause order
body: Use Nej, inte … utan … to correct a detail.
Useful repairs are Jag vet inte, Jag förstår inte, Det fungerar inte.
Subordinate order comes later; focus now on main clauses.

sections.title: Finite verb second; inte after it
body: Neutral order is subject + finite verb + inte: Jag arbetar inte idag.
With a fronted element, keep verb second: Idag arbetar jag inte.
With a modal, inte follows the modal: Jag kan inte komma.

examples.en: I do not live in Helsinki.

assignment.title: Episode 18 mission: Negation and main-clause order
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear twice and answer: Where does the speaker work today?

READ: Read for purpose and detail. Answer: What changed?

SPEAK: Correct day, time, and place. Try once unaided, then improve one detail.

WRITE: Write a rescheduling message with two negatives. Check word order, forms, and purpose.

TRANSFER: Move a time phrase to front and repair order.

RETURN: Rebuild Jag arbetar inte / Idag arbetar jag inte.
